subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should `agent:bootstrap` internal hook handlers intentionally yield to the event loop between ordered handlers?
rationale: The hook system promises registration order, but whether unrelated callbacks may interleave between mutable bootstrap-context transformations is an owner-level runtime contract choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept cooperative bootstrap scheduling
options.body: Keep the internal-only yield and document and test ordered handlers as sequential transformations that may have unrelated event-loop work interleaved.

options.title: Keep handlers uninterrupted
options.body: Remove inter-handler yielding and land only the asynchronous workspace reads, cooperative glob traversal, and timing diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Accept cooperative bootstrap scheduling
recommendation.body: Keep the internal-only yield and document and test ordered handlers as sequential transformations that may have unrelated event-loop work interleaved.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the internal hook system, agent bootstrap hook, and centralized bootstrap resolution path affected by this choice.
